pure-announcement.rationale: It is top-of-funnel product documentation for Google's Agent Registry rather than a launch or funding note, though it never rises above the product's own value bullets.

duplicate.rationale: remote-first-mcp-governance and paved-road-mcp-platform cover remote deployment control and template-inherited governance, not the central catalog/inventory pattern with an Agent/McpServer/Skill/Publisher data model this page describes.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The claims describe a shipping Google Cloud product whose data model and setup are checkable against the linked official docs.

durability.rationale: The content is a vendor feature summary of one Google Cloud product — three marketing pillars plus resource names tied to the current API surface — and the durable registry-as-governance idea appears only at bullet depth.

actionability.rationale: It describes what the product does and links to setup elsewhere; there is no mechanism, trade-off, or decision guidance a reader could act on beyond knowing the catalog exists.

atomicity.rationale: One idea — a centralized registry of agents, MCP servers, and skills as the inventory-and-governance pillar of an agent platform — states cleanly in a paragraph.
